{{Quote|Air support we ''still'' have... from a ''local'' source.|Yoda|<ref name="Seeds" />}}
This '''species''' of [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]] originated from a [[Unidentified farming moon|farming moon]] in orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. These creatures dropped seeds from their beaks over the [[Farm/Legends|farmlands]] of their [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. During a [[Battle on an unidentified farming moon|battle]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used one of those reptavians to reach the roof of a [[scythe harvester]].<ref name="Seeds" />
